selection.purpose: Select one genuinely new bounded neural capability, not implement or calibrate it.

structural_provenance.query_normalization: Rows ordered by query ORDER BY; landing collect(source_ids) explicitly sorted before canonical response hashing.

queries.query: MATCH (n:Neuron) WHERE n.type IN ['HSE','HSN','HSS','H2','DNp15','LC16','MDN','DNp07','DNp10'] RETURN n.bodyId AS body_id,n.type AS type,n.instance AS instance,n.somaSide AS side ORDER BY n.type,n.bodyId

MATCH (s:Neuron)-[e:ConnectsTo]->(t:Neuron) WHERE s.type IN ['HSE','HSN','HSS','DNp15'] AND t.type IN ['HSE','HSN','HSS','DNp15'] RETURN s.bodyId AS source_id,t.bodyId AS target_id,s.type AS source_type,t.type AS target_type,e.weight AS structural_count ORDER BY s.bodyId,t.bodyId
MATCH (s:Neuron)-[e:ConnectsTo]->(t:Neuron) WHERE s.type='LC16' AND t.type='MDN' RETURN s.bodyId AS source_id,t.bodyId AS target_id,e.weight AS structural_count ORDER BY s.bodyId,t.bodyId

MATCH (s:Neuron)-[e:ConnectsTo]->(t:Neuron) WHERE s.type IN ['LC4','LPLC2','HSE','HSN','HSS','LC16'] AND t.type IN ['DNp07','DNp10'] RETURN s.type AS source_type,t.type AS target_type,count(e) AS edge_count,sum(e.weight) AS structural_count ORDER BY s.type,t.type
MATCH (n:Neuron) WHERE n.type IN ['LPLC3','LPLC4','DNp07','DNp10'] RETURN n.bodyId AS body_id,n.type AS type,n.instance AS instance,n.somaSide AS side ORDER BY n.type,n.bodyId

MATCH (s:Neuron)-[e:ConnectsTo]->(t:Neuron) WHERE s.type IN ['LPLC3','LPLC4'] AND t.type IN ['DNp07','DNp10'] RETURN s.type AS source_type,s.somaSide AS source_side,t.bodyId AS target_id,t.type AS target_type,t.somaSide AS target_side,count(e) AS edge_count,sum(e.weight) AS structural_count,collect(s.bodyId) AS source_ids ORDER BY s.type,s.somaSide,t.bodyId

selection.selection_rationale: Only the narrowly scoped HS→DNp15 neural feedforward probe passes G1–G8. Selection rests on verified directed routing, explicit bilateral motion inputs and public type-level functional evidence, not body movement or product appeal. Missing electrical/recurrent physiology limits its claims, not concealed by a full course-control promise. Other nominated boundaries lack a verified relay or source identity/context.

first_validation_design.question: How do explicit left/right horizontal-motion inputs propagate through the verified HS→DNp15 chemical-routing motif under preregistered exploratory dynamics?
first_validation_design.input: Prescribed hemifield horizontal-motion descriptors to six identity-resolved HS-linked proxy states; no rendered-world geometry or biological angular calibration.
first_validation_design.subgraph: Eight verified identities and six selected directed feedforward chemical edges. Retain all 13 induced edges as provenance; exclude seven explicitly.
first_validation_design.output: Both DNp15 model states/events, per-source contributions and derived bilateral difference, with uncalibrated units declared. No body output required.
first_validation_design.pre_execution_freeze: Future phase must preregister encoder/state/target dynamics, effective sign/magnitude/normalization/latency, dt/horizon and control schedules before any new neural execution. No values selected in Phase 24.
model_independent_invariants: Only structurally selected ipsilateral source routes eligible
No stimulus fallback or injected output
All states and events have causal provenance
first_validation_design.model_dependent_expectation: Side-swapped readout equivariance is testable only if future dynamics and input conventions are explicitly side-matched; not assumed biological bilateral equality.
first_validation_design.acceptance: Accept zero, weak, asymmetric or unexpected-but-valid genuine results. Validate causal composition/identity/provenance, not spikes or visibly correct steering.
first_validation_design.embodiment: Neural validation only. No TTM actuator shortcut; yaw/body embodiment remains out of this first slice.
